dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: If there's nothing too urgent that needs your attention, why not take a seat and relax for a bit? I'll make you some tea.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Oh, don't mention it, it's nothing, really! I'd hate to see anyone who needs my care tiring themselves out too much.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: How're you feeling? Try not to worry too much about the next fight!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I've heard people say that having a good attitude actually benefits your health.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Even if spearmanship isn't my strong suit, I'll do my best to protect you in this battle!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: When I was little, my mother often read me bedtime stories. Back then, I thought the world was just like in those stories, and everyone led peaceful, happy lives.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: It was only later that I realized the difficulties and struggles many people face in society. All I can do is try my best, and stay loyal to the people I care about.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, even though the stories are fictional, they can still help children get a good night's sleep. To me, that's enough.
